rules.title: A Collab Effect requires an actual Collab action; moving a Holomem into Collab by effect does not trigger it
rules.expectedBehavior: A Collab Effect is a triggered ability whose condition is that its Holomem Collabs. When hBP09-050 moves an opposing Holomem into the Collab position by its effect, that movement is not treated as a Collab action and does not trigger the moved Holomem's Collab Effect (official Q725). The movement also does not record a Collab action for that opponent; this counter behavior is verified in the reducers and follows from the movement not being a Collab action.

rules.title: A hidden-zone search may fail to find a matching card even when one is present
officialRulingSources: https://hololive-official-cardgame.com/cardlist/?id=2808 (hBP09-091/Q734 for direct staging; hidden-zone choice governed by the Comprehensive Rules)
rules.expectedBehavior: When a player must choose a card from a hidden zone and obtaining card information is necessary, the player may fail to find even if a matching card is present. Do not turn such a search into a mandatory exact-count choice. This does not mean the effect is optional when a match is visible in a public zone or when the rule/effect specifically requires a public selection.
applicationScope: Website deck-search effects and pending cardSelection validation
Production Android offline NativeRules bundle
